title: Final Answer
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly state the final expression for the differential cross section as dσ/dΩ = R^2/4.

title: Scattering Angle Relation
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly relate the scattering angle to the impact parameter and incidence angle, showing that φ = 2θ.

title: Differential Cross Section Derivation
description: Important Criteria: The student must derive the expression for the differential cross section using the relationship between b, R, and θ.

title: Isotropic Conclusion
description: Important Criteria: The student should conclude that the scattering is isotropic based on the derived expression.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional Criteria: The student should check that the units are consistent throughout the derivation.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must avoid common errors such as sign mistakes or incorrect relationships between variables.
